description: Recent trading in aggregate over the last 24 hours and 7 days: trades, buys, sells, distinct buyers, distinct sellers and distinct traders (a wallet that both bought and sold counts once, so traders is not buyers plus sellers). Counts of wallets, never the wallets themselves. `truncated` true on a window means it could not be read in full, so its counts are a floor rather than a total. Every trade feeds the vault, so this is the activity the treasury is funded by. Read-only.
name: get_recent_activity
